billing.label: Billing
billing.vat: Prices incl. VAT for consumers · business VAT at checkout
billing.annualNote: Billed yearly · about 20% less, set per market

changePlans.a: Yes. Upgrades are prorated today; downgrades apply at the next billing date and never delete data.

cancel.a: Yes, in two taps. Paid features stay until the end of the period you paid for.

fighterPays.q: Does a fighter need to pay to work with a coach?
fighterPays.a: Never. Coach-assigned training, messages and booking are free for fighters.

annual.a: One payment per year, about 20% less than monthly. Exact prices are set per market.

processing.a: No — processing is charged by the payment provider per transaction and always shown before you sell.

commission.a: Only when SimpleFit introduces a new client through the marketplace. The rate is shown on every sale.

international.a: Yes. Prices show in your currency (EUR, USD, GBP, PLN) with local taxes calculated at checkout.

coach.note: Fighters you coach never pay to train with you. Plans limit active fighters — archived fighters keep their history.
